presentation.name: Build data quality controls: quarantine, release diff, scorecards
presentation.summary: Builds the controls that keep invalid records out of published data, show what each publish changes, and score data quality per source and stage.
benefits: Quarantines failing records at the smallest entity, with a reason the source can act on, and resolves them on a passing rerun
Stops a batch on structural changes, so a dropped column is not reported as mass data loss
Compares each publish with the last one per entity and field, against thresholds kept in configuration
Scores each source against all sources, before and after processing, with exports safe to share with one source
Leaves room for an approval gate and bundled releases without rebuilding the pipeline
